retrievalProfile.description: A low-key nighttime urban scene featuring a subject perched on a luxury vehicle with heavy film grain and high-contrast highlights.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition where a central luxury SUV serves as a stage for a seated figure, defined by specular highlights against a deep black background with heavy analog-style grain.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject seated atop the rear roofline of a dark vehicle
High-contrast headlights and chrome grill against deep shadows
Diagonal perspective of the car leading from bottom-left to mid-right
Heavy monochromatic grain texture overlaying the entire frame
coreInvariants: Specular highlights on metallic and plastic surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is small-scale, positioned in the upper right quadrant; the vehicle occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, illuminated front grill and headlights of the car.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright headlights along the car's body line up to the seated figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper left and top margins creates a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal (background and car body)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm white and amber (headlights and side markers)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle red (jacket lining) and yellow (road line)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Very low saturation overall with high value contrast in light sources.

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular badge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans-serif for utilitarian labeling.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the advisory label.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean sans-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a nighttime urban scene with a black luxury SUV parked on a dark street. A person in a black puffer jacket sits on the roof. Apply heavy film grain and high contrast lighting focusing on the car's chrome grill.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small white rectangular badge in the bottom right corner containing black condensed sans-serif text stacked in three lines.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Is the subject seated on the roof of the car?
Is the lighting low-key with deep blacks?

adjustableVariables: Position of the subject on the car
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos on the car
Do not replicate specific artist likeness

mustAchieve: Clear focal point on the car's front

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast specular highlights on the car
Ensure the grain does not obscure the subject's silhouette
Verify the text badge is positioned in the lower right corner
Confirm the overall mood is dark and urban
recipe.reuseFormula: Nighttime Urban Scene + Luxury Vehicle + Seated Subject + High Contrast + Heavy Film Grain = Cinematic Album Aesthetic
